svg.title: Worker throughput, before and after, and as it scales
svg.desc: One commit per event drained 5,185 events per second; one commit per poll drained 12,349. With 12 partitions, 1, 2 and 4 workers drained 16,921, 27,335, 36,264 events per second.
svg.text: events per second the worker stores, 498,360 events already in Kafka
the fix: one commit per poll
after: more partitions, then more workers
3 partitions cannot feed more than 3 consumers: extra workers sit idle
